about: Laval is a suburban city on Île Jésus, immediately north of Montréal in Québec. It is the province’s second-largest city after Montréal and a major residential and commercial part of Greater Montréal. Highways, shopping centres, and a growing Métro line tie it to the island. About 440,000 people live in Laval.
seoSummary: Québec’s second-largest city, a north-shore suburb of Montréal on Île Jésus.
knownFor: Carrefour Laval and suburban commercial strips
